formula: Let me put it this way: + complete clause

formulas.formula: Let me put it this way: + complete clause

example: Let me put it this way: we can delay the launch, but we cannot ignore the defects.
exampleZh: 讓我這樣說吧：我們可以延遲推出產品，但不能忽視產品的缺陷。

examples.en: Let me put it this way: we can delay the launch, but we cannot ignore the defects.
examples.zh: 讓我這樣說吧：我們可以延遲推出產品，但不能忽視產品的缺陷。
examples.highlight: Let me put it this way: we can delay the launch, but we cannot ignore the defects.

rules.zh: 核心固定表達是【Let me put it this way:】。前面或外圍的字詞可以改變，但這個固定表達本身應保持完整。讓我這樣說吧：這個計劃可以實行，但需要更多時間。 嗯，讓我這樣說吧：房間雖小，但我們需要的東西一應俱全。 經理說：「讓我這樣說吧：數字正在改善，但風險仍然存在。」 經理停頓了一下。讓我這樣說吧：數字正在改善，但風險仍然存在。
rules.en: Core Expression The core expression is: Let me put it this way: Let me put it this way: The words before or around it may change, but the expression itself should remain complete. Let me put it this way: the plan is possible, but it needs more time. Well, let me put it this way: the room is small, but it has everything we need. The manager said, “Let me put it this way: the figures are improving, but the risks remain.” The manager paused. Let me put it this way: the figures are improving, but the risks remain.

rules.zh: 前面的字詞並非固定部分。以下字詞可以放在固定表達前：【Well,】、【Frankly,】、【To be honest,】、【If I may,】、【In practical terms,】和【For the sake of clarity,】。例句【To be honest, let me put it this way: the meal was acceptable, but I would not order it again.】 老實說，讓我這樣說吧：這頓飯可以接受，但我不會再次點選。 為免產生誤解，讓我這樣說吧：期限可以調整，但安全標準不能降低。 這些開首字詞只是可以選擇加入的延伸部分，並不屬於固定表達本身。
rules.en: The Words Before It Are Optional Words such as the following may appear before the expression: Well, Frankly, To be honest, If I may, In practical terms, For the sake of clarity, To be honest, let me put it this way: the meal was acceptable, but I would not order it again. For the sake of clarity, let me put it this way: the deadline is flexible, but the safety standard is not. These opening expressions are optional additions. They are not part of the fixed expression.

rules.zh: 冒號後須有完整子句冒號後通常應接一個包含主語和動詞的完整陳述。讓我這樣說吧：產品可以運作，但並不可靠。 冒號後只有名詞詞組，並非完整子句。
rules.en: A Complete Clause Must Follow the Colon The words after the colon should normally form a complete statement containing a subject and a verb. Let me put it this way: the product works, but it is not reliable. The clause contains: subject: the product verb: works Let me put it this way: an unreliable product. The words after the colon are only a noun phrase, not a complete clause.

rules.zh: 以【Shells】為例：句型可放入不同語法框架讓我這樣說吧：巴士較便宜，但火車較快。 嗯，讓我這樣說吧：這份工作很困難，但能提供寶貴經驗。 我不能簡單地回答是或不是。讓我這樣說吧：這項建議很有潛力，但仍有幾項細節並不清楚。 醫生回答：「讓我這樣說吧：康復的機會很高，但過程不會很快。 讓我這樣說吧：天分或許能為你打開大門，但練習才能令大門保持開啟。」教練回答。 以上五種形式都包含相同的核心固定表達。
rules.en: The Expression Can Appear in Different Grammar At the beginning of the answer Let me put it this way: the bus is cheaper, but the train is faster. After an opening expression Well, let me put it this way: the job is difficult, but it offers valuable experience. After a context sentence I cannot give a simple yes or no. Let me put it this way: the proposal has promise, but several details remain unclear. After a reporting clause The doctor replied, “Let me put it this way: recovery is likely, but it will not be quick.” Before a reporting clause “Let me put it this way: talent may open the door, but practice keeps it open,” the coach replied. All five patterns contain the same core expression.

rules.zh: 它用來換個方式說明，而非突然轉換話題這個表達後面的內容，應以另一種方式重新表達、簡化、澄清或加強正在討論的觀點。這項建議有數項優點，但亦帶來嚴重風險。讓我這樣說吧：它很有潛力，但尚未準備妥當。 我們正在討論建議。讓我這樣說吧：我的弟弟買了一輛新單車。 第二個觀點與原本的討論沒有關係。
rules.en: It Introduces a Reformulation, Not an Unrelated Idea The clause after the expression should restate, simplify, clarify or sharpen the idea being discussed. Natural: The proposal has several advantages, but it also carries serious risks. Let me put it this way: it has promise, but it is not ready. Unnatural: We were discussing the proposal. Let me put it this way: my brother bought a new bicycle. The second idea is unrelated to the discussion.

rules.zh: 語氣通常直接但有所緩和以【Let me】為例：令整個表達比 Put it this way 較為緩和，沒有那麼生硬。這樣說吧：如果沒有更多資金，計劃將會失敗。 讓我這樣說吧：如果沒有更多資金，計劃將會失敗。 第二句稍為有禮，因為說話者表示自己正在提供另一種解釋方式。
rules.en: The Tone Is Often Direct but Controlled Let me makes the expression less abrupt than Put it this way. Compare: Put it this way: the plan will fail without more funding. Let me put it this way: the plan will fail without more funding. The second version sounds slightly more polite because the speaker signals that they are offering another explanation.

rules.zh: 在 Let me put it this way 後面，可按意思使用現在、過去、未來、情態動詞或條件句；本課考核的是固定引導語，而不是某一特定時態。它可以說明系統現在的表現、活動過去的結果、延誤將造成的問題、可做與不可做的事，或忽視警號的條件後果。後續比較部分另作補充，不改變這個核心原則。
rules.en: Different Tenses and Clause Types May Follow the Present: Let me put it this way: the system works, but it is slow. Past: Let me put it this way: the campaign attracted attention, but it did not change public opinion. Future: Let me put it this way: delaying the decision will create more problems. Modal: Let me put it this way: we can replace the machine, but we cannot recover the lost data. Conditional: Let me put it this way: if we ignore the warning signs, the problem will become more serious. The target is the introductory expression, not one particular tense. Differences from Similar Expressions

rules.zh: 與 In other words 通常用來直接重述或總結前面的意思。維修費用將高於機器本身的價值。換句話說，我們應該更換機器。 除了重述意思，也可以引出更明確的判斷、比較或容易令人記住的說法。讓我這樣說吧：維修並非不可能，但更換會比較安全。 與 To put it another way 通常緊接前面剛說過的內容，表示換一種方式重述。公司的支出高於收入。換句話說，公司正在虧蝕經營。 較為着重說話者本身，語氣亦通常較為口語化。
rules.en: Let me put it this way In other words normally gives a direct restatement or summary. In other words The repair will cost more than the machine is worth. In other words, we should replace it. Let me put it this way may also introduce a firmer judgement, a comparison or a more memorable explanation. Let me put it this way Let me put it this way: repairing it is possible, but replacing it is safer. Let me put it this way To put it another way usually connects closely to a statement that has just been made. To put it another way The company has spent more than it has earned. To put it another way, it is operating at a loss. Let me put it this way is more speaker-centred and often sounds more conversational. Let me put it this way

rules.zh: 與 Let me be clear 強調接下來的訊息不應被誤解。我要說清楚：員工必須立即報告所有安全問題。 目標表達【Let me put it this way】表示說話者將以另一種或更清楚的方式表達觀點。讓我這樣說吧：及早報告問題可以保障所有人。 與 Put it this way 較短，語氣可以較強硬或直接。這樣說吧：你比我們更需要對方。 一般較為緩和，因為 let me 以較有禮的方式引入另一種說法。本練習須使用完整目標句型：【Let me put it this way:】
rules.en: Let me put it this way Let me be clear emphasises that the following message must not be misunderstood. Let me be clear Let me be clear: staff must report all safety problems immediately. Let me put it this way signals that the speaker will express the idea in another or clearer form. Let me put it this way Let me put it this way: reporting a problem early protects everyone. Let me put it this way Put it this way is shorter and can sound more forceful or abrupt. Put it this way Put it this way: you need us more than we need you. Let me put it this way is generally softer because let me introduces the reformulation more politely. Let me put it this way For this exercise, use the complete target expression: Let me put it this way:

benefits.zh: 當原本的解釋過於複雜，或對方未能掌握你的重點時，你可以使用這個句型重新說明。讓我這樣說吧：我們仍能按照時間表完成工作，但幾項重要細節仍未確定。
benefits.en: It Helps You Explain a Difficult Idea More Clearly You can use the expression when your first explanation is too complicated or when another person does not understand your main point. Complicated explanation: The timetable remains operationally achievable, although several dependencies have yet to be confirmed. Simpler explanation: Let me put it this way: we can still meet the timetable, but several important details remain uncertain.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以提醒聽者，接下來便是整個解釋中最重要的部分。讓我這樣說吧：問題不在能力不足，而在缺乏方向。
benefits.en: It Helps You Present the Main Point Directly The expression tells listeners that the most important part of the explanation is coming next. Let me put it this way: the problem is not a lack of ability it is a lack of direction.

benefits.zh: 說話者在提出批評、拒絕要求或說出令人不舒服的事實前，可以使用這個句型稍為緩和語氣。讓我這樣說吧：我明白你為甚麼提出這項要求，但預算無法負擔。
benefits.en: It Can Make a Difficult Message Sound Less Abrupt A speaker can use the expression before giving criticism, refusing a request or presenting an uncomfortable truth. Let me put it this way: I understand why you are asking, but the budget cannot support it.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以引出比喻、對比或簡短有力的說法，令觀點更容易記住。讓我這樣說吧：高強度密碼是一把鎖，但隨便分享密碼便等於把門打開。
benefits.en: It Helps You Introduce a Comparison or Memorable Image The expression can prepare the listener for an analogy, contrast or short statement that makes the idea easier to remember. Let me put it this way: a strong password is a lock, but careless sharing leaves the door open.

benefits.zh: 這個固定表達可以成為實用的口語框架。你在說出這句話時，可以同時整理接下來較清楚的解釋。它特別適合用於：討論；面試；會議；簡報；辯論；較難處理的對話。
benefits.en: It Gives You Time to Organise a Spoken Answer The fixed expression acts as a useful speaking frame. While saying it, you can prepare the clearer explanation that comes next. It is especially useful in: discussions interviews meetings presentations debates difficult conversations.

benefits.zh: 除了反覆使用 I think、In my opinion 或 In other words，你也可以使用這個句型引出重新整理過的觀點，使說話和寫作更有變化。
benefits.en: It Gives You More Varied Sentence Openings Instead of repeatedly beginning answers with I think, In my opinion or In other words, you can use this expression to introduce a reformulated point.
